column2: A photograph of an early-1980s box of 5.25-inch floppy disks for a company called "phin tech", on a wooden desk in warm light. The box is a bold single-colour design in the style of early-80s computer media packaging: a big friendly cartoon of the dog in the reference image (Pepper, a cream mutt with floppy ears, one ear orange with a brown patch), drawn in thick confident black ink lines with flat spot colour, sitting proudly, with the slogan "Pepper never forgets." in a chunky 1980s typeface and "phin tech" below. An original design, not resembling any existing brand.

A photograph of a single 5.25-inch floppy disk in its paper sleeve, early 1980s, on a beige surface. The disk's label shows a friendly mascot cartoon of the dog in the reference image (Pepper, a cream mutt with floppy ears, one ear orange with a brown patch) in thick black ink lines with one flat spot colour, holding a pencil in its mouth, and the words "phin tech" in a heavy rounded 1980s typeface, with lines for writing. An original design.

An original early-1980s corporate mascot logo, flat two-colour print (black ink and warm orange) on cream: a friendly cartoon of the dog in the reference image (Pepper, a mutt with floppy ears) in thick, confident black brush lines, head tilted, one ear up, inside a bold circle, with "phin tech" in a chunky 1980s typeface arched beneath. Clean vector-like linework, no gradients. Not resembling any existing brand.

An original early-1980s computer-company mascot logo: a friendly cartoon of the dog in the reference image (Pepper, a mutt with floppy ears), drawn in thick black ink lines, sitting beside a stack of floppy disks, with six thin rainbow stripes (green, yellow, orange, red, purple, blue) running behind it like a horizon, and "phin tech" in a heavy rounded 1980s typeface below. Flat colour, cream background.

A 1982 computer magazine advertisement for "phin tech" diskettes, printed on slightly yellowed paper: a large cartoon of the dog in the reference image (Pepper, a mutt with floppy ears) in bold black ink, balancing a floppy disk on its nose, the headline "Pepper never forgets." in a heavy serif, a short block of placeholder-looking body text, and the "phin tech" wordmark at the bottom. Halftone print texture.

A macOS app icon: a rounded square in warm cream with a thin orange border, containing a friendly mascot cartoon head of the dog in the reference image (Pepper, a mutt with floppy ears, one ear orange with a brown patch) in thick black ink lines with flat colour, in the style of early-1980s computer media packaging. No text.
